notes.content:

[h3]Don’t adjust your screens and refresh the browsers or Steam clients!  
You’re seeing well, this devlog is about something totally different than usual![/h3]

On the occasion of the ongoing campaign on Kickstarter, we’re helping our brother, [b]Climber: Sky is the Limit[/b], get some well-deserved attention! 


Our studio, together with A2 Softworks, didn’t expect the project to be nominated in 2 categories on such prestige event as [b]gamescom 2021[/b]. Nominations gave us a lot of motivation, and fuel for future development but like in every game cycle, there is a time when developers need some help from their community. 

This time has come for us, that’s why we would like to invite you all to Climber: Sky is the Limit’s campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/climberskyisthelimit/climber-sky-is-the-limit]KICKSTARTER[/url]! 

For the next few weeks on Kickstarter, we’re going to collect funds and feedback from the gamers to polish the game and astonish everyone with its final form! 

At this stage of development, all help is welcomed. That’s why if you can’t (or don’t want to) help us through Kickstarter but you’re willing to support us in any form, even a small action like leaving feedback or adding the game to your wishlist on Steam will help us a million!

notes.title: New game about Vietnam War by WallRus Group!
notes.content:
Hello there!

It's been 2.5 months since the release of "When I was young" and we are happy that during this time we have new reviews, and bugs, on the contrary, have disappeared!

[h3]Meanwhile, our team started working on a new game: [/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1423260/RocknRoll_Card_Wargame/ ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/7cad3bbf23acd7a27e70231d4e7b4f17e2d9d499.png[/img][/url]

This project is a digitalization of the card wargame from the indie board game developer Loki in the setting of the alternative and post-apocalyptic Vietnam War ːRedStarː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/008c0c6351e5cea06711c1137978c4e107829b95.png[/img]

US Marines and Vietnam partisans, welcome to Rock'n'roll: Card Wargame - a card wargame with interesting game mechanics and a unique visual style that will send you on a crazy alternative-historical trip through the chemical-drenched jungles of the Vietnam war. Take on the role of a commander of Vietnamese guerrillas or US armed forces and show your opponents what you're made of!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1423260/RocknRoll_Card_Wargame/

[h3]Features:[/h3][list]
[*] 28 different cards: 12 units and 16 orders will make each game session in Rock'n'roll: Card Wargame unique and catchy.
[*] Exciting mechanics of capturing strategic points on the battlefield, which is rarely seen in card games.
[*] Each win will bring you points, which can be used to purchase customized items that allow you to collect a unique game set from the deck, dice, and playing field.
[*] Author's graphics in the modern comics style, transmitting the unique setting of the game.
[*] Rock and roll soundtrack that complements the game atmosphere.
[*] 25 achievements to achieve which you will need to show perseverance and ingenuity.
[*] After each battle, your units will get experience, and over time you will be able to improve them into real hardened veterans.
[*] In between online battles, you can try 2 story campaigns, both of which will tell a fascinating story of the conflict from different sides.
[*] For already experienced players there also will be multiplayer modes: 1 vs 2, 2 vs 2.
[/list]

[h3]So add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to news (Early Access release is scheduled for Q1 2021). See you in this damned jungle, commander![/h3]

notes.content:

notes.title: Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]We are glad to announce that in a few days our game will be available in Early Access! ːsteamhappyː[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34919535/814a8ea860b01a3fcb45ace5d529697e76cadc71.png[/img]

[h3][i]Why Early Access?[/i][/h3]
“Early access will help us to make our game as high quality as possible, thanks to feedback from players who are waiting for it.”
Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
“About 3 months.”

[h3][i]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/i][/h3]
“In the full version of the game there will be a little more levels. The soundtrack and possibly the art book will be available as DLC. There are also plans to make collectible cards, backgrounds and icons. We hope to be able to implement Steam Cloud.
You can follow the news on social.”

[h3][i]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/i][/h3]
“There are just over 6 chapters available in early access ( that's 85% of the narrative) and all the basic mechanics:[list][*] shooting and reloading
[*] aiming
[*] relocation and construction
[*] climbing on stairs
[*] explosions, murders, etc
[*] following the NPC for player
[*] Many types of enemies (NVA and VC), weapons and military vehicles (Gun truck, M113, PBR MKII, etc);
[*] A variety of game missions:
[*] story telling
[*] territory cleanup
[*] holding positions
[*] item search
[*] stealth, etc
[/list]
About 20 unique locations:[list][*] 60s in America
[*] Jungle
[*] Vietnamese villages and town
[*] Military bases and training camp
[*] Tunnels, etc
[/list]
Full (or almost full) soundtrack.
Also 20 achievements from 28 planned are realized.

This part of the game will not change for release, except on the technical side or with corrected errors in the text.”

[h3][i]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/i][/h3]
“We price during the Early Access will be 20% to 40% lower than the final price.”
